description: Returns all of the properties of a topic. Topic properties returned might differ based on the authorization of the user.

researchLinks.description: Don’t expose yourself in public - let AWS error messages do it for you
Detect Public Resource Exposure via Session Policy Error Messages

securityImplications: Attackers might use GetTopicAttributes to read an SNS topic's properties, including its resource policy, to find topics that are publicly or cross-account accessible. When the call is made with a deny-all session policy, the access-denied error reveals the resource policy's decision without touching the topic or leaving a trace in the target account.
